الحَيْدَرَةُ (assumed tropical:) The lion; (S, K;) as also ↓ الحَيْدَرُ , (K,) and ↓ حَيْدَرٌ , without ال, (TA,) and ↓ الحَادِرُ : (Kudot;:) or the lion that is, among other lions, like the king among men; (IAar;) because of the thickness of his neck, and the strength of his fore legs. (Th, TA.) ―
-b2- Also حَيْدَرَةٌ (tropical:) Destruction, or perdition; (AZ, K;) and so ↓ حَادُورٌ : (K:) or a severe calamity; as though it were a lion in its severity. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
